name: Air Fryer Tilapia
why: The fastest real dinner in this kitchen. Frozen fish, straight from the bag, no thawing and no pan to wash.

ingredients.display: Cajun seasoning, or paprika + garlic powder
lemon, or 1 tbsp bottled lemon juice
a handful of arugula, 1 fresh bell pepper
ingredients.note: Optional garnish. Was linked to the spice rack.

steps.text: Take 2 fillets straight from the freezer and run them under cold tap water for about 30 seconds to rinse off the frost. Pat them dry with paper towel.
steps.look: You are not thawing them, only removing the ice glaze that would steam them. They will still be hard and frozen in the middle. That is correct.
steps.warn: Cold water only. Warm water starts cooking the outside while the middle is still frozen, which gives you a rubbery edge.

steps.text: Smear about 1/2 tablespoon of mayonnaise on each fillet, both sides.
steps.look: A blob the size of a grape per fillet. Same trick as the chicken: mayonnaise is oil and egg, it stops the surface drying and gives seasoning something to grip. It does not taste like mayonnaise afterwards.

steps.text: Season both sides with 1 tsp of Cajun seasoning and 1/4 tsp of kosher salt spread across the two fillets.
steps.look: Tilapia is a very mild fish. Underseasoned it tastes of almost nothing, so this will look like more seasoning than you expect and it is not.

Lay them flat with a gap between them. Crowding steams fish instead of roasting it.Done when the flesh flakes. Press the thickest part with a fork and twist gently: cooked fish separates into distinct white flakes, raw fish stays as one springy piece and looks slightly translucent. If it resists, give it 2 more minutes.With the thermometer: 145°F in the thickest part.
steps.warn: Fish goes from done to dry faster than any meat here. Start checking at 10 minutes. There is no recovering an overcooked fillet.

steps.text: Squeeze half a lemon over the top, or a tablespoon of the bottled juice, and eat.
steps.look: Acid is not optional on a mild white fish, it is what makes it taste like something. Serve on a handful of arugula with a sliced bell pepper if you want to use those up.Roughly 44 g of protein: 22 g per 125 g fillet, off the bag.
